integrity: Proof and standalone finite checks accompany this claim; finite tests do not prove the limiting assertion.
scientific_limitations: Fixed n only, weak convergence, no convergence rate or explicit higher-type CDF. Stochastic integral limit uses standard martingale FCLT and smoothing of the argmax selector; the local-time normalization is symmetric. Priority comparison is qualified by potentially unindexed broad rank-diffusion limit theorems.
title: Brownian top-rank local time for fixed-type complete-feedback card guessing
